name: Prinx Chengshan Holdings Limited
summary: Prinx Chengshan Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, researches and develops, designs, manufactures, and sells tires and related products. The company offers steel radial, semi-steel radial, and bias tires used in medium/long-distance transportation, buses, mixed road or off-road vehicles, light trucks, passenger vehicles, pick-up trucks, sport utility vehicles, agricultural, industrial offroad, and other vehicles under the Prinx, ChengShan, Austone, and Fortune brand names.
